rate_limits.correction: Rate limited (HTTP 429 when exceeded); exact numeric limits not published. Docs require a descriptive User-Agent; excessive catalog scraping can lead to permanent blocks.

description.correction: CheapShark tracks digital PC game prices across stores including Steam, GreenManGaming, Fanatical, GOG and others; docs do not list Epic as a tracked store. API is free (must use CheapShark deal links); no API key. Supports deals, games, stores, and email price alerts.

notes: Docs confirm free public API at /api/1.0, no key, User-Agent required, rate limits with 429 (limits unpublished). Description overclaims Epic; rate_limits 'not published' understates that limits exist. CORS left unknown without live check.
